name: tinyhttp
description: HTTP/1.1 header and chunked-body reader written in curl's coding style: return type on its own line, function-like macros, static prototypes (src/httpd_min.c).

versions.message: tinyhttp 1.1: drop obsolete header line folding

bugs.title: Header array overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` appends to the fixed array of HTTP_MAX_HDRS headers without checking `nhdrs`, so the 33rd header line writes past the array inside the request struct.
bugs.poc: Send a request with 40 header lines.

bugs.title: Header name overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies the header name into a 64-byte field using the distance to the colon, with no upper bound.
bugs.poc: Send a header whose name is 300 bytes long.

bugs.title: Unbounded whitespace skip using {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` is used in a loop that skips blanks after the colon without any length bound, so a header line that ends in blanks is read past its end.
bugs.poc: Send 'X:' followed by spaces up to the end of the buffer with no newline.

bugs.title: Chunk size integer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` accumulates hex digits into a size_t with no overflow check, so a 17-digit chunk size wraps to a small value.

bugs.title: Body buffer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies the declared chunk size into the fixed 8192-byte body without comparing it to the space left or to the bytes actually received.
bugs.poc: Send the chunk header ffff followed by 10 bytes.

bugs.title: Over-read on the header/body boundary in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` hands everything after the blank line to the chunk decoder, which then trusts a size taken from that data.
bugs.poc: End the headers and send a chunk size larger than the rest of the input.

bugs.title: Unbounded strcat in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` concatenates every header name into `out` with strcat and no size, so many headers overflow the caller's buffer.
bugs.poc: Dump a request with 32 long header names into a 256-byte buffer.

bugs.title: Out-of-bounds write in {fn}()
bugs.summary: When the first header line starts with a blank, `{fn}()` folds it into `hdrs[-1]`, writing before the header array.
bugs.poc: Send a request whose first header line begins with a space.
